name: Certificate of Deposit for APY Calculator
meta_title: CD APY Calculator: Convert a CD Rate to APY and Back
meta_description: Convert a CD interest rate and compounding into the APY a bank must disclose, or an APY back to its rate, using the Truth in Savings formula for any term.
subtitle: Turn a certificate of deposit's stated interest rate and compounding into its annual percentage yield, or work back from an APY to the rate, using the Truth in Savings formula for terms shorter or longer than a year.
